# sendgrid_api_key (Data Source)

Retrieves an existing SendGrid API key's name and scopes by ID. The secret value is never returned by the API and is not available here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sendgrid_api_key" "mail_send" {
  id = "abcd1234"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The API key ID.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) A descriptive name for this API key.
- `scopes` (Set of String) The permissions granted to this API key.
